title: A platform ranking
bodyMd: A marketplace ranks sellers by average customer ratings. A seller with three perfect ratings appears above one with hundreds of ratings averaging slightly less. The platform’s analyst suggests showing rating counts and an uncertainty indicator. She does not argue that the smaller seller is necessarily worse; she argues that its average is based on less evidence.
